purpose: A small multi-domain retrieval and citation pilot; not a comprehensive medical knowledge base.

source_policy.allowed_content_scope: Only the Summary section from each MedlinePlus Health Topic page.
source_policy.license_status: Public domain for MedlinePlus Health Topic summaries, according to NLM usage guidance.
source_policy.attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
excluded_content: A.D.A.M. Medical Encyclopedia articles or videos
AHFS Consumer Medication Information / drug monographs
third-party linked articles, PDFs, images, or videos
page navigation, related links, journal citations, and advertisements
source_policy.date_semantics: source_last_updated records the page's displayed Last updated date. It is not publication_date and does not assert that every sentence was clinically reviewed on that date.

document_defaults.license: Public domain MedlinePlus Health Topic Summary; attribution requested: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
document_defaults.content_capture_scope: Summary section only; preserve headings and paragraph boundaries.
